name: DBeaver
description: The inspected DBeaver source supports a narrow primary C observation: a version-selected installer is downloaded to a temporary file and later executed by platform-specific launch code after user confirmation. No hash or signature verification is present in this control flow; the HTTP/TLS and version descriptor parsing helpers are separate boundaries.
limitations: Newly retrieved snapshot at the recorded commit, not historical release verification.
WebUtils.downloadRemoteFile and VersionDescriptor source/transport behavior were not used to infer cryptographic guarantees.
The cited path covers Windows/macOS installer execution; Linux falls back to the download page.
